The X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis revealed that SnS 2 consisted of Sn 4+ and S2% valence states. Transmission electron microscope (TEM) analysis of the cross-section was used to examine the film thickness and crystallinity of the SnS 2 films. The transmittances and optical bandgaps of SnS 2 films with different thicknesses were measured by ultraviolet –visible spectroscopy (UV –vis). The resistivities of SnS 2 with various thicknesses were determined by current –voltage ( I–V ) measurements (B1500A).
